Reachable keeps the content of a declarative shadow root

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ConversionOptions, HiddenContent, convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const options: ConversionOptions = { hiddenContent: HiddenContent.Reachable };
  const result = convert("<div><template shadowrootmode=\"open\"><p>shadow body</p></template><span>light body</span></div>", options);
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
